subject: [PATCH 43/60] mm/page_alloc: fall back when a bind policy's nodes become private

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses memory hotplug issues in the Linux kernel's page allocation mechanism. Specifically, it handles cases where a bind policy's nodes become private after memory removal, leading to infinite fault retries. The patch relaxes the private request condition by dropping the nodemask and allocating from common memory when no node is available.
